messages:
Lydia (AE): Kicking off POC with Acme — running into two blockers: the model they want is not available in eu-west1 and we're also seeing intermittent 429s during burst tests. Can we swarm?
Miguel (SE): Got it. Which model + exact error? Can you paste the log snippet?
Lydia (AE): Error from their test harness: 
```
HTTP 404: model not found: model_pico_v2 in region eu-west1
request_id=01F9XQ4R
```
Also during throughput tests we hit:
```
HTTP 429: rate limit exceeded
X-RateLimit-Limit: 120
X-RateLimit-Remaining: 0
X-RateLimit-Reset: 12
```
Nora (Support): Sharing the account id and region would help. Is this on Hosted or Dedicated?
Lydia (AE): Hosted, account id acme-corp-354, region eu-west1. They signed up via self-serve but asked for enterprise pricing / dedicated commit if we can't support production QoS.
Miguel (SE): Two things: 1) model availability — some model variants were not onboarded to eu-west1 by default. We can check model alias fallbacks. 2) 429s look like burst-rate limits for hosted tier. Can you try a lower QPS or add a retry/backoff?
Devon (Platform): Quick check: routing table shows model_pico_v2 deployed only in us-central1 and us-west2. eu-west1 has model_pico_v2-8q (quantized) and model_pico_v1. Short-term workaround: point requests to model_pico_v2-8q in eu-west1 or route to us-central1 with region affinity. If they need the exact fp32 variant, we can schedule onboarding to eu-west1 but that takes ~48-72h.
Lydia (AE): Customer insists on the non-quantized model for accuracy tests. They said quantized outputs differ on subtle NLU tests.
Raj (SRE): For the 429s, check the project's per-minute burst limit and any IP-based throttles. If this is a POC we can temporarily raise rate limits for acme-corp-354 (low-risk) or spin a short lived Dedicated worker pool for the POC — that'll also address region routing if we provision in eu-west1. Need approval from sales eng for committed credits.
Elena (Sales Eng): I can propose a POC addendum: 2-week Dedicated trial in eu-west1 with a modest commit to avoid throttles. I'll draft terms (credits + data handling). Pricing question from Acme: what is the incremental cost to run Dedicated POC vs. hosted throttle bump?
Miguel (SE): Hosted throttle bump = minimal operational lift, configurable in console (quota override). Dedicated trial = infra cost but predictable latency; also lets us pin model version. If they require exact model binary pinned, Dedicated is the only guarantee.
Nora (Support): Lydia, can you confirm if they already submitted the security questionnaire? Private data/PII? Dedicated requires KMS integration if they need customer-managed keys.
Lydia (AE): Security Q filled partially; they're asking about KMS and audit logs. I'll push the remaining items tonight.
Miguel (SE): While security gets sorted, here's a technical short-term option: use model aliasing in the API to force fallback to the eu-west1 variant that is closest. Example curl: 
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.example/v1/generate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" \
  -d '{"model":"model_pico_v2-8q","input":"..."}'
```
We can also pin by version if eu-west1 gets the exact binary later: `model: \"model_pico_v2@2025-09-15\"`.
Lydia (AE): Will present options to Acme: 1) run quantized variant in eu-west1 now for latency, 2) short Dedicated POC in eu-west1 (requires commit), 3) route to us-central1 but will add latency. Also ask them if small accuracy delta is acceptable.
Raj (SRE): If they pick Dedicated POC, tag task for infra to provision a single-node pool in eu-west1 and set autoscale to 1-4. I'll add a temporary quota override in the hosted control plane meanwhile.
deploy-bot: Deploy request accepted: queue=eu-west1-dedicated-provision job_id=deploy-8821 status=queued
Nora (Support): I'll prepare a troubleshooting checklist for the 429s (headers to capture, request pattern, retries/backoff sample).
Elena (Sales Eng): I'll also include a pricing annex: Dedicated 2-week trial estimate vs hosted bump. Lydia, loop me into next call with Acme.
Lydia (AE): Thanks team — action items: Elena draft POC pricing annex, Raj/Devon confirm provision ETA, Miguel provide model alias test commands, Nora finalize support checklist, I'll update the security Q and confirm customer preference. Will post back with decision. :thumbsup:
